The report itemizes 20,750 STRCx worth $1,984,945 within the settlement wallet; normalized slices are STRCx 94.059174%, other unitemized Ethereum Settlement Wallet assets 0.814359%, Stacks Redeeming Reserve 0.380820%, and Reserve Fund USDC 4.745648%. Copper, Ceffu, Mint Wallet, and Reserve Fund USDh were $0.
